name: DCA Monthly Compliance Report Date for Process Servers
description:
This dataset is a monthly compliance reference for process servers, covering 83 consecutive months. Each row represents one month and records three dates: the month itself (month_year), a randomly generated audit date within that month (randomly_generated_audit), and a second, alternate randomly generated date (alternate_randomly_generated). All three columns are stored as date-like text values, and no entries are missing.

The data appears to support scheduling or tracking of monthly compliance audits, where the two generated dates could serve as candidate audit dates or as a primary and backup date for each reporting period. It could be used to build audit calendars, test date-based reporting logic, or provide sample monthly dates for compliance workflows involving process servers. Because the audit dates are randomly generated rather than actual recorded events, the dataset is best suited for demonstration, planning, or template purposes rather than historical analysis.
